说明: 本批补充固定预取、现代损坏缓存与性能证据采集；测试代码和便携工具已审查，不把准备好的 iOS 用例当成执行通过。

changes.implementation: Two owned 20/100-chapter fixtures enter ten distant targets through the real ReaderViewModel, live adapter, fetch manager, coordinator, source parser and WebFetcher. URLProtocol holds each response until explicitly released; the existing HTTP semaphore reports read-only Debug permit/queue snapshots.
observations: HTTP acquired permits and queued requests
responses drained to reach queued targets
real cancellation signals and successful re-entry
changes.scope: No new scheduler/cache, no live site or user source, no timing waits; transport counts are not total app-wide chapter-job counts. Failure cleanup is best effort and does not wait without a deadline.

changes.implementation: After a valid cache write, change only its body (replacement, empty/truncated, invalid UTF-8), preserving package/meta. Reopen twice to contrast lightweight cached status with checksum rejection and exact unchanged bytes. A second scenario proves prefetch skips that lightweight hit, actual entry fetches once, and a new manager reuses the validated recovered package without another request.
changes.scope: Repository probes preserve the invalid bytes; successful on-demand source fetch replaces the rejected cache through the existing writer. Failed-network cache retention and physical-storage faults are not established by these cases.

changes.implementation: The existing ChapterFetchManager accepts a MainActor Sendable source resolver; its default still performs the same indexed BookSourceStore lookup. Owned tests inject a synthetic source and do not mutate the source store.

Runtime rows include fixture SHA-256/bytes/minimum UTF-16 and actual render/style settings. An offline collector independently reconstructs public fixture HTML and requires all 50 unique fixture/iteration/stage rows, finite times, valid output counts, passing 60/62 XCTest summary, matching Git source and actual Xcode/SDK/runtime/destination evidence. Raw rows survive failure; accepted output contains median/max only.

changes.problem: The original normalized XCUI drag stopped at an announced 6%, failing the exact 5% endpoint check in source 44eee1c.
changes.implementation: Move the native thumb near its center, then drag to the track edge. Keep exact 5% and 100% assertions and use the real native close button. No production brightness change, sleep, retry or relaxed endpoint gate.

preparedIntegration.configuration: Debug Simulator; source-only; no native JVM execution or IPA

processColdLaunch.fixture: Owned TXT imported through the existing Debug hook, then import input removed and app terminated; retain file SHA-256 and persisted spineIndex/charOffset.
processColdLaunch.measurement: A fresh process launch per sample, ending at first usable reader content with expected text and anchor. Fixture preparation and import are outside the measured interval.
processColdLaunch.limits: Process-cold is not OS/device cold: filesystem, Simulator and package caches are not purged. No measured values exist yet.

peakProcessMemory.fixture: Owned 100K and 1M UTF-16 chapters, fixture construction outside the interval; 390x844 viewport, 18pt, line-height 1.5 and paragraph spacing 8.
peakProcessMemory.measurement: Record process baseline before entry and sampled peak during opening, full pagination, scrolling and ten distant jumps. Record footprint/RSS units and sampling interval, separately from document-stage timings.
peakProcessMemory.limits: A sampled process peak is not allocation churn, a memory-pressure test or a physical-device memory limit. Collection code and runs remain outstanding.

independentReview.scope: Static plan, source/evidence hashes, fixture reconstruction and acceptance boundaries; no iOS execution.

remaining: Execute the exact new source on macOS/Xcode and audit the raw results.
Review real font-page/panel rendering, large text, contrast, VoiceOver order and iPad window/anchor behavior.

Traditional rules remain on JSC; no complete AnalyzeRule/AnalyzeUrl/WebBook or host migration is claimed.
Self renewal, legal source closure, release candidate and device acceptance remain incomplete.

checkpointSubmission.fixStatus: Owned test root canonicalized; 20 focused portable guards passed locally. This failed source remains failed; acceptance requires the corrected source checkpoint.
